# Beats16 Events & Entertainment

> Beats16 is a live music company in Mumbai, started by Tushar Sonigra. It plays Indian weddings and traditional festivals across India and abroad, with 5,000+ events and 80+ Navratris organised. Its bands: Gauri for wedding rituals and pheras, RDX (a wireless band) for sangeet nights and private events, Daastan-e-Ghazal for ghazal evenings, and the Navratri band by Beats16 for garba and dandiya.

Site: https://beats16-events.vercel.app

## Bands

- [Gauri](https://beats16-events.vercel.app/gauri): Wedding rituals and traditional ceremonies, including the pheras.
- [RDX](https://beats16-events.vercel.app/rdx): Wireless band for sangeet nights and private events.
- [Daastan-e-Ghazal](https://beats16-events.vercel.app/daastan-e-ghazal): Ghazal evenings for cultural programmes, community gatherings and private events.
- [Navratri band by Beats16](https://beats16-events.vercel.app/navratri): Live garba and dandiya. Beats16 has organised 80+ Navratris.
- Independent bands: put together for private shows that are not one of the four bands above.

## Record

- 5,000+ events, weddings and festivals
- 80+ Navratris organised
- Home base: Mumbai
- Performs across India and abroad

## What Beats16 plays

Indian weddings, including mehendi, sangeet, pheras and reception. Traditional festivals such as Navratri. Also cultural programmes, religious celebrations, community gatherings and corporate events.

Each wedding function gets its own musical plan.

Beats16 specialises in Indian weddings and traditional festivals. For a different kind of ceremony, Beats16 says so plainly and kindly.

Pricing is discussed personally once Beats16 knows the date, city and functions. Dates are confirmed only after a conversation with Tushar Sonigra.
